messages:
nora: Heads-up: getting multiple customer reports of 502/504s from hosted inference in eu-west, started ~10:03 UTC. Symptoms: streaming chunks failing, clients hit read timeouts. Opening thread to coordinate.
amelia: Oncall here. Jumping in — seeing apigw spike for upstream 502s and p95 token latency climb. Can folks dump quick repros and affected route IDs?
mike: Support: ACME reported chunked streaming failing with 'read timeout' + 502. Their curl shows: `curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` -> 502. They attached live trace id: trace-ACME-117.
raj: eng-runtime: correlating logs — pattern looks like KV cache key eviction + routing to a small model variant that doesn't handle concurrent streaming well. Fallback policy didn't fire because variant labels didn't match expected tag. Sample log: ```apigw error upstream reset id=pod-42 conn_reset code=502 route=gen-eu-01``` 
teresa: product: do we have a quick canary rollback plan? Also we should prep customer comms (brief, technical, ETA).
amelia: Mitigations I'm executing now: 1) force route override to fallback-model-v2 for the affected route (temp, 30m) 2) bump gateway concurrency limits on eu nodes 3) flip stricter circuit breaker for variant routing. Applying (1) first.
nora: I applied the route override: route_id=gen-eu-01 -> model=fallback-model-v2, ttl=30m. Monitoring p50/p95 and error rate.
raj: Deployed a hotfix to routing service to fix the label-compare bug (variant label normalization). PR: https://git.internal/routing/123 — root cause: labels like "v.small" vs "variant:small" mismatch prevented fallback rule match.
ops-bot: deploy routing/patch-123 to prod eu; status: success. rollout=33% -> 100% in 4m.
mike: ACME reports initial improvement after override — fewer 502s, streaming resumed for most requests. I'll keep them updated. :thumbsup:
teresa: Action items (owners): - RCA write-up & timeline (raj) - Add e2e test for variant label normalization (amelia) - Update routing canary + rollback checklist (teresa) - Customer comm draft & send (mike) - Review KV cache eviction heuristics (raj + infra)
amelia: Created ticket INF-4621 for e2e test, assigned to eng-devex, ETA end of week.
raj: Starting postmortem draft, adding timeline and logs. Note: autoscaler delayed replacing some overloaded pods because node pressure paused scale-up; adding that to investigation.
nora: Scheduling 1hr retro tomorrow 09:00 UTC; invited eng-runtime, infra, oncall, support, product. Also we should review warmup/warm cache strategy for streaming-heavy tenants.
mike: Confirmed ACME wants a short postmortem summary + ETA for permanent fix. I'll consolidate external-facing text after RCA draft.
raj: Will backport routing fix to dedicated/private images and coordinate patch release v1.2.3. Will also add integration test in the release pipeline.
nora: Current status: degraded -> recovering. Continue monitoring for 2h, then close if stable. Thanks all — good quick coordination. :white_check_mark:
